problem:
Consider the vector $x$ and the subspace $S=\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,\,x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 5 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the acute angle between $x$ and the subspace $S$ given that the set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is orthogonal.

activity_context.topic_title: Projecting Vectors Onto Subspaces in Euclidean Spaces (Orthogonal Bases)
